# Generated by gase-recomp for "@TITLE@" (ROM CRC32 @CRC@).
#
#   Desktop:  cmake -S . -B out && cmake --build out --config Release
#   Headless: cmake -S . -B out -DGASE_HEADLESS=ON && cmake --build out
#   Android:  open android/ in Android Studio (see BUILD.md)
#   iOS:      ./ios/generate_xcode.sh (see BUILD.md)
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(@ID@ C)

option(GASE_HEADLESS "Build the headless runner (no window) instead of the app" OFF)
set(GASE_SDL2_SOURCE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Build SDL2 from this source tree (mobile)")

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()

# ---- the game: runtime + recompiled code ------------------------------------
file(GLOB GASE_GENERATED CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/*.c)
add_library(gase_core STATIC
  runtime/src/cpu.c runtime/src/bus.c runtime/src/io.c
  runtime/src/system.c runtime/src/vdp.c runtime/src/psg.c
  ${GASE_GENERATED})
target_include_directories(gase_core PUBLIC runtime/include generated)
set_target_properties(gase_core PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(gase_core PRIVATE /bigobj)
else()
  # Generated code has labels nobody jumps to: that's expected.
  target_compile_options(gase_core PRIVATE -Wno-unused-label)
endif()

if(GASE_HEADLESS)
  add_executable(game_headless runtime/src/platform_headless.c)
  target_link_libraries(game_headless PRIVATE gase_core)
  return()
endif()

# ---- SDL2 ---------------------------------------------------------------------
if(GASE_SDL2_SOURCE_DIR)
  enable_language(CXX)            # SDL's Android HIDAPI backend is C++
  set(SDL_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(SDL_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(SDL_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  add_subdirectory(${GASE_SDL2_SOURCE_DIR} SDL2 EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
  set(GASE_SDL SDL2::SDL2-static)
else()
  find_package(SDL2 REQUIRED)
  set(GASE_SDL SDL2::SDL2)
endif()
if(TARGET SDL2::SDL2main AND NOT ANDROID)
  list(PREPEND GASE_SDL SDL2::SDL2main)
endif()

# ---- the app ----------------------------------------------------------------------
if(ANDROID)
  # SDL's Java activity loads "libmain.so".
  add_library(main SHARED runtime/src/platform_sdl.c)
  target_link_libraries(main PRIVATE gase_core ${GASE_SDL})
else()
  add_executable(game WIN32 MACOSX_BUNDLE runtime/src/platform_sdl.c assets/rom.bin)
  target_link_libraries(game PRIVATE gase_core ${GASE_SDL})
  set_target_properties(game PROPERTIES
    OUTPUT_NAME "@ID@"
    RESOURCE assets/rom.bin
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_GUI_IDENTIFIER "org.gaserecomp.@ID@"
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_NAME "@ID@"
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_SHORT_VERSION_STRING "1.0"
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_VERSION "1")
  if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "iOS")
    set_target_properties(game PROPERTIES
      MACOSX_BUNDLE_INFO_PLIST ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ios/Info.plist.in
      XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY "1,2")
  elseif(NOT APPLE)
    # Put the ROM next to the executable on Linux / Windows.
    add_custom_command(TARGET game POST_BUILD
      COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/rom.bin
              $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:game>/rom.bin)
  endif()
endif()
